The structure of composition Mg12Mn2Ni2 (Mg6MnNi) adopts the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg, Mn, and Ni each have 12 geometric neighbors, with neighbor distances from about 2.96 to 3.27 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
